title: Concurrent event syncs are not single-flighted: the same rows are POSTed twice and a fresh device can mint several anonymous accounts
Event sync with more than 500 rows re-sends already-accepted batches when a later batch fails, creating duplicate server rows
A transient failure of the refresh-token call signs the device up as a new anonymous user, orphaning the listener's identity
races-4 fix is incomplete: listener-action writes and first-run detection still run against an unhydrated store and permanently overwrite durable rows
cp_saved keeps full untrimmed snapshots (publisher description and chapters) and is re-parsed once per rendered row
Unbounded session caches: showEpisodesCache and state.itemIndex hold full episode descriptions for every show visited
playerBridge leaks a 'forayplayer:ready' listener on every timed-out wait
Dead code in the search section: episodeDedupKey and showIndexFetchCount
showNameLink builds `#/show/<id>` without encodeURIComponent, while the router decodes the segment and the prefetch handler decodes the whole tail

On the Vercel origin the service worker intercepts /api/* and keys its cache without the query string, so a slow or failing API call returns another query's results; those responses also survive Delete my data
The service worker's activate deletes every CacheStorage bucket it does not own, including the app's own 'foray-shows-index-v1' shard cache, on every deploy
The service worker strips the Range header when it refetches same-origin media, so the interlude jingle always gets a 200 full body (Safari expects 206)
idb-tier (and event-log) cache an IDBDatabase handle forever and never reopen after the connection is closed
listProgress over DurableStore is O(n²): key(i) and length rebuild the owned-key array on every call
TtlCache never evicts, and the show-scoped path has no rate limit: unbounded memory growth and outbound feed-fetch amplification
The CI `api` job installs with `npm install`, but Vercel installs with `npm ci`, so CI can pass on a lockfile/manifest mismatch that breaks the production deploy
The iOS build paths (including the TestFlight release action) still use `npm install` under a stale 'no committed lockfile' comment, while Android uses `npm ci`
Catalog and pipeline tables have no RLS, so on Supabase the public anon key can insert or modify catalogue episodes
parseFeed throws on an out-of-range numeric entity, so a show's episode page returns HTTP 500 in production
The build number is not monotonic: the run_number wrap (99 -> 1) on the same UTC day makes both stores reject every later release that day, and then the retry budget stops the trigger
Hourly pr-hygiene sweep arms and merges fork PRs from outside contributors, and app.js, sw.js, player/ and mobile/ are all on the auto-merge allowlist
The live episodes endpoint's DB branch has drifted from its no-DB branch: no pagination, different response shape, and connect() can 500
Feed fetchers outside scan.mjs skip the M1 byte cap (and backfill-show has no timeout); fetch-limits' header wrongly claims refresh-feeds uses it
sameEpisodeList compares `id`, but show-episode rows only carry `guid`, so any same-length refresh counts as unchanged
Show-scoped search rows for feeds without guids all get the id `<show>--null`, so they collide and tapping one row plays another row's audio
Generated playlists (#/playlist/gen-<leaf>) often say 'Playlist not found' after a reload or relaunch: an incomplete fix of qa 116
redealAfterOnboardingPicks undoes the first deal before that deal has been recorded when storage is still settling, and corrupts cp_recent_branches
With Continuous playback off, a finished episode is never removed from Up Next
_bufferedEvents grows without bound for the session when the player module never loads
branchChain sorts by `new Date(release_date || 0)`, so an unparseable date gives a NaN comparator: the bug dateValue() already fixed elsewhere
prettyTitle drops every non-ASCII letter, so accented or non-Latin queries produce broken or generic playlist titles
retryCatalog repaints and refocuses whatever page is current when the retried fetch lands, even after the listener has left
Home render overwrites the last-played episode's full itemIndex entry with the player's 7-field pointer, and it stays that way for the session
Shows search paints every match with no cap: about 2,500 rows on the first keystroke, and the whole list is re-rendered on each later pass
Leaving the Search page does not supersede its passes, so the debounce tick, three fetches and the multi-second playlist-CTA scan still run on the next page
Starting an episode from a chapter or timestamp tap skips startEpisodePlay: no History entry, no play_started event, and the previous list's ⏮/⏭ chain stays in place
loadShowIndex bounds only the response headers; a stalled body leaves showIndexPromise pending for the whole session (incomplete fix of states-4)
Clearing or changing a thumbs vote never reverses its interest nudge, so up, clear, up repeated drives a topic to 1.0
Episode-notes timestamp guard uses the rounded duration_min and ignores duration_sec, so real chapter stamps in the last minute render as dead text
Linkifier cuts URLs that end in ')' , so Wikipedia-style links in show notes open the wrong page
'Shows 4a vouches for' is not deterministic across locales: the base order uses a locale-sensitive localeCompare
Panel drag-to-dismiss doesn't capture the pointer; a mouse release off the panel leaves the drag stuck
Search CTA hands off to Create through location.hash plus setTimeout(0), racing the hashchange render
Home computes every rail twice per render, including generatedPlaylists' full-pool scan and sort
Foray route links interpolate ids without encodeURIComponent, which has drifted from the other producers
Foray page Play after the mini bar is closed restarts from the resume point captured at render time (or from 0), not from where the listener stopped, and then writes over their stored progress
The 'generation-changed' notice ('one version behind') is broadcast to pages that already loaded the new deploy, so returning visitors see it after every deploy
The generation pin is also applied to code that loaded live from a newer deploy, so new app.js reads the previous generation's data (the #233 mismatch)
Retrying Delete my data after a 'device NOT fully clear' result reports the server rows wrongly ('never signed in' or 'NOT deleted') and can block the device clear
The voice picker's subtitle says Preview plays 'at your playback speed', but auditions have been fixed at 1x since the 2026-09-24 ruling
renderForay calls player.playbackRate() without checking it exists; with an older module the throw strands the Foray page with an unbound transport
Voice sheet async races: overlapping Previews re-enable a voice that is still speaking, and an older refreshVoiceList can overwrite a newer one
runVoiceProbe has no in-flight guard, so a second tap starts a second ~90 s probe alongside the first
init() has no catch after its first await, so a throw in boot leaves 'Loading 4a…' on screen for good, with ☰ and ↻ disabled, no Try again, and no service worker
A service-worker test and comment claim a response that lands after the timeout 'warms' the generation cache, but cachePut makes that a no-op for every manifest-tracked file
Pressing previous-clip after a failed Foray load marks the whole Foray Played and restarts it from clip 1
Pause or Stop during a rendered narration bridge's load is ignored: the bridge starts playing anyway
An interrupted play() (AbortError) is reported as a fatal player error, which drops the listener's skip into idle
A synth narration load superseded while speak() is in flight still marks itself loaded and keeps talking over the next item
Scrubber and clocks freeze for the rest of the session if a drag returns to its starting value
Foray 'Next clip' silently skips narration clips, and ends the Foray early when the last item is narration
stop() does not enforce silence the way pause() does (#689 drift survives Stop)
playForay drops the outgoing episode's and Foray's position (no flush), unlike play()
Concurrent _handle calls can run a stale loadItem after a newer one, leaving the reducer's target different from what is loaded
Known-car-route auto-resume is dead code: routeChanged(available) is never called and _knownCarRoutes is never filled
One hung IndexedDB transaction stalls every later durable write, including the vault write of a refreshed auth token, and makes Delete my data hang
DiagnosticLog rewrites the whole 200-entry ring through every storage tier on every row and every seam stage
Transport click handlers drop the promise from async setRunning/forayNext/forayPrevious/foraySeek, so a rejection skips the repaint and leaves the Foray index stuck
Media-session playbackState/positionState dedupe is recorded before the write, so a failed write is never retried (the metadata fix was not applied to these two)
Modifier words are consumed as filters unconditionally: 'deep learning' returns 805 random long episodes with status ok
'constructor' in a topic query hits Object.prototype: the token is silently dropped, or the search throws a TypeError
No per-show feed cache: every show-page search keystroke and every episode page re-downloads and re-parses the whole RSS feed
Helper modules and api/test/*.mjs sit under api/ without a leading underscore, so Vercel deploys each one as a public function
Topic-search tokenizer does not fold diacritics, so accented queries split into junk 'thin' fragments
Index proxy marks unversioned URLs 'immutable' and fetches upstream with no timeout or size cap
showIdMap: release id-map fetch has no timeout, and one failure pins the fallback map for the instance's lifetime
Dead CSS: rules for #pl-form/#pl-input, .cards4 and the ui-v2 utility classes match no markup
passesFilters recency: an episode with an unparseable release_date passes a 'new'/'today' filter, while one with no date fails it
episodes-search tests share the real-clock Apple bucket singleton and never reset it
Web-search replies are parsed from the FIRST text block, so the JSON is missed and the re-ask (sent without the search tool) gets passages written from memory
Tape evidence window is truncated from the end, so any clip longer than about 100 s loses its tail from the verifier's and writer's view
Deepened slot titles are never pinned to the spine's, but items are keyed by the deepened title and `slots` by the spine's
slotsFromSpine suffixes duplicate slot ids (-2) but items still use the unsuffixed slug
Evidence prefetch caches transient retrieval failures as empty packs, so narration never asks again
Tier-2 item ids collide for episodes whose titles share 60 slug chars, so one episode's audio and transcript can be attributed to another
Transcript body lookup's prefix fallback can return a different episode's body
Q-09 cross-act show memory is never wired, so every act re-introduces a show by name
Safety regexes reject ordinary documentary prompts, against the DECISIONS intent to avoid false positives
Truncated (max_tokens) replies are silently repaired into valid JSON for continuity, deepen, spine and verifier
postSeedSpine.ts contains a raw NUL byte, so git treats it as binary: no diffs in PRs, invisible to git grep
finalizeForay throws, instead of returning ok:false, on pool collisions and duplicate ids, which bypasses refusedPartial 'continue' and can loop on resume
Foray id and topic are re-derived on every resume, so a resumed run publishes under a different id than its streamed partials
Re-ask calls are not recorded in usageTracking in 5 of 7 builders, so pipelineTokens and report `calls` undercount
Transcript cue cache and caches keyed without `root` grow or go stale for the process lifetime
runPhonemizer silently drops all phonemes on any subprocess failure, including ENOBUFS from spawnSync's 1 MB default buffer
Learning cursor truncates Postgres microseconds to milliseconds, so the last event is re-applied on every run
Learning job trusts unvalidated event payloads: one malformed row crashes the run and stalls the user's cursor for good
own_rows policies are `for all`, so clients can rewrite the append-only interest audit log and forge learned weights or event timestamps
publish-foray adds the `hold` label in a second call after `gh pr create`, so a failed label call leaves a --force'd Foray auto-mergeable
generate-forays rewrites report.json from this run only, dropping rows (and their publish records) for candidates it skipped as already built
warm-transcript-index --show X overwrites corpus-digest.json with only X's rows, dropping every other show from the archive
ingestShowFeed is not atomic and breaks its 'never throws' contract: a NUL from `�` or any failing row aborts the ingest mid-upsert
An empty <guid></guid> becomes guid "" rather than null, so guid-less episodes collide on (show_id, "") and all but one are lost
decodeEntities looks named entities up on a plain object, so `&constructor;` becomes 'function Object() { [native code] }'
ingestShowFeed records consecutive_failures but never reads it, so a dead feed is refetched (with a 15 s timeout) on every request
BudgetGuard checks and records in separate awaited steps, so concurrent calls can all pass the cap
warm-transcript-index's feed fetch has no timeout, no size cap and a cache that never expires
sessionBuilder's dedup log names the wrong kept candidate (it can report keptId === droppedId)
An unparseable release date is scored as 1970 (freshness 0) instead of the neutral 0.5 computeFreshness provides
The card-ignored penalty fires again on every card_shown after the 5th, and the streak is recomputed in O(n^2)
The INTERNAL_VOCABULARY 'Act N' rule only matches lower-case number words, so 'Act Two' passes the title/summary gate
publish-foray leaves the checkout stranded on the publish branch if commit, push or `gh pr create` fails
The real-data suites gate spawns `node --test` with no timeout, so one hung suite hangs publish-foray forever
build-session crashes whenever DATABASE_URL is set, which is the same .env that migrate and learn-interests require
normalizeTitle removes every non-ASCII letter, so non-Latin titles never dedup and all collide on one identity key
The path policy ignores renames (previous_filename), so moving a governed file to an allowlisted path auto-merges unread and passes path-policy

The release-signing secrets are repository-scoped, so the release guard is not a boundary: a tag or branch push runs its own guard code with access to the dist cert, the App Store Connect key and the Play key
`mobile/` is allowlisted wholesale, including the signing Gradle include, plugin build scripts and package manifests, which run inside the steps that hold the keystore password and the ASC key
release-trigger treats main as 'red' when an advisory, non-required ci.yml job fails (ios-kit, playwright), which blocks automatic releases
The sweep's ARM path skips the truncated-file-list guard, so it re-arms PRs that automerge-nightly refused as TRUNCATED_FILE_LIST
A same-repo PR can edit automerge-nightly.yml to arm itself, because pull_request runs the PR's copy of the workflow
The shared concurrency groups with cancel-in-progress:false still drop runs: GitHub keeps one pending run per group and cancels the older one
The self-heal's dispatch guard treats ANY non-dispatch ci.yml run as coverage, so a cancelled or startup_failure run strands the PR permanently
The TestFlight upload error message tells the reader to 'see altool-upload.log in this job's artifacts', but the release path never uploads it
crlf-guard's binary exemption is a hand-kept list, but the font list it guards is derived from the directory, so adding a font breaks every deploy build
prepare-dist deletes whatever `--out` points at before building, so `--out .` or `--out ..` wipes the checkout, and a bare `--out` crashes
nightly-refresh's 'Restore scan state' treats any API failure as 'no state', silently resetting and then overwriting the seen-guid state (the fail-open the guard step was fixed for)
The PR gathers cap at 100 open PRs, so the AUTOMERGE_FREEZE kill switch never reaches armed PRs past the first 100
iOS ForayTts.speak() queues behind a paused or still-speaking utterance, so after any skip away from a narration line the next narration is silent
The 'finished' TTS event carries no utterance identity, so a stale completion advances whichever narration is current
Android TTS onError is a no-op, so an engine error leaves narration 'speaking' in silence until the page's deadline
A Foray that ends on narration never deactivates the app's audio session, contrary to the documented 'only the end of playback deactivates' rule
Kokoro probe on Android leaks an ORT session per run and blocks every Capacitor plugin call while it runs
iOS lock-screen artwork: one failed or timed-out fetch caches 'no artwork' for that URI for the rest of the item
Android DeviceOnlyVault cannot recover from a corrupt file: set/remove parse it first, so the vault stays broken permanently
Android SSML path is latent-broken: overlapping lexicon matches duplicate text, and resume() speaks a substring of the SSML markup
webview-probe's DevTools target fetch has no timeout, so a hung endpoint hangs the CI job past the probe deadline
Relay answers a fresh request with a previous run's stale reply file (ids restart at r0001, queue never cleared on start)
Nightly resolve fuzzy-matches a new episode to a different (older) iTunes track, and the episode is then dropped for good
Corpus fetcher throws out of fetchUrl when a body read times out mid-stream, aborting the whole ingest run
fetch-audio's resume identity check never runs: identity and bytes_expected are only written after a download completes
fetch-audio's 120 s abort timer covers the whole body stream, so long episodes cannot finish and DAI episodes never do
'Two bytes, no audio' probes download the whole episode when a host ignores Range
A driver killed by a signal is reported as success (exit code null becomes 0)
SizeOverrun/DiskBudget failures leave the .part file on disk while the ledger releases its bytes
HostGate's minimum gap is not enforced between concurrent slots on the same host
backfill-audio / classify-dai write discover.json (and the DAI cache) before checking the session.json text patch, which can then throw
Startup launcher for the events server runs the stale commute-curator checkout, not this repo
sweep-transcripts' entity decoder throws RangeError on an out-of-range numeric entity (a third, drifted decoder)
Shows import always emits changed.json = every show (previousNewest hard-coded {}), so scan --source index is a full scan plus an unbounded candidates list
resolve.mjs dedups ids against the trackId set (dead check)
Playwright 'new deploy' specs never install a second generation: sw.js bytes never change, so re-register()/update() is a no-op and the tests pass whatever sw.js does
boot-path perf-3 whenQuiet test depends on wall-clock timer order and fails when the process stalls ~45 ms
Search load-state tests order nested product timers against fixed real sleeps: a stall turns positive tests into flakes and the offline test into a vacuous pass
No CI job sets timeout-minutes and the root node --test run has no --test-timeout, so one hung test holds the runner for 6 hours
Timezone-sensitive date tests cannot fail in CI, because CI runs in UTC where local and UTC formatting are the same
suite-integrity floors have enough slack that large parts of some suites can be deleted without failing it
Placeholder tests that assert nothing pad the floors and read as coverage
The gitignore guard for audio-cache/ probes with .mp3, which the global *.mp3 rule already ignores, so it cannot detect the directory rule being removed
showsWeVouchFor test passes if the function returns an empty array
The fake DOM in boot-path and load-states ignores attribute values in selectors, so [data-x="id"] returns the first element with data-x
boot-path 'hydration NEVER finishes' test spends at least 4 s of real time waiting out a hard-coded 4000 ms ceiling
ci.yml has no permissions block while the repo default token is write-all, so PR code and its dependencies run with a write token
Generation relay on localhost accepts cross-site text/plain POSTs to /answer/:id (ids are sequential) and /reset, with no Origin or Host check
Dead events-server binds every interface (the log says 127.0.0.1), accepts unauthenticated writes that fill the disk, over-reports what it stored, and uses the relay's port
The Apple rate buckets are shared by every caller per instance, so one client can use up the directory and episode search for all listeners
UX prototype page with no CSP and unescaped innerHTML is served from the app's own origin, which holds the Supabase session
Vercel deploy sends no frame-ancestors / X-Frame-Options / nosniff headers, and the meta CSP cannot supply frame-ancestors
Family mode lets explicit content through: 157 pool episodes have no `explicit` flag, and show pages skip the filter entirely
cp_lastpick is write-only: nothing reads it, but every pick still stores a full untrimmed episode snapshot
No validator cross-checks the two copies of dai_suspected or that each shipped segment is actually queueable, so a flag drift silently drops tape
learning_cursor is a per-user server row that 'Delete my data' cannot delete
A data file that times out is served from the previous deploy's cache to live new code, with no pin and no notice (the #233 mismatch)
Every 4 Hz player tick re-parses cp_saved and cp_queue and runs planAfterEnded, through EPISODE_NAVIGATION getters
The Foray page repaints at 4 Hz while the document is hidden: notifyForay/paintForay is not gated the way paintPage is
Publish gate uses a stricter quote normaliser than the narration gate, so quotes the writer accepted fail groundedQuoteRate
D13 shows dedupe key is ASCII-only, so every guid-less show with a non-Latin title and author collapses into one group
Jingle item runtime is hard-coded to 1.5 s and labelled MEASURED, but the asset it plays is the 3.0 s interlude file
Four drifted copies of the itunes:duration parser in tools/ reject decimal seconds that the backend parser accepts
search-probe's normaliseTitle claims to be verbatim from the API/app rule but lacks the NFKD diacritic fold
POINTER_SCHEMA_VERSION is dead; buildPointer hard-codes version 1 even though S-04c changed the pointer's shape
Dead backend modules: feeds/redirect.ts, feeds/politeness.ts (with a stale DAI host list), clients/itunes.ts, clients/podcastIndex.ts, curation/ladderProgress.ts
Three clock formatters round differently, and seek-policy's 'ONLY approved way' comment is false
api/*.ts is never type-checked: the backend typecheck gate added on 2026-09-12 does not cover the Vercel functions
API handlers restate the feed User-Agent literal instead of importing the backend constant the tools scan pins
diagnostic-record tests wait on real wall-clock sleeps with a 250 ms margin over the seam beat
